entries.sense_note: say something is good to try

def.micro: say a thing is worth trying
def.short: tell someone that something is good and that they should try it
def.long: To tell someone that a film, book, place or product is good and that they should try it, often because you liked it yourself. Doctors and experts also recommend things.

examples.en: Nina recommended a great series to me.
examples.tr: Nina bana harika bir dizi tavsiye etti.

examples.en: Which book would you recommend for a long flight?
examples.tr: Uzun bir uçuş için hangi kitabı tavsiye edersin?

examples.en: I recommend booking a table, because the place is always full on Fridays.
examples.tr: Masa ayırtmanı tavsiye ederim, çünkü orası cuma günleri hep dolu oluyor.

etymology.text: From Medieval Latin 'recommendare', from 're-' and Latin 'commendare' (to praise, to give into someone's care).

tr.note: 'Recommend' çoğu zaman denediğin ve beğendiğin bir şeyi önermektir: film, kitap, restoran. En doğal kalıplar: 'I recommend watching it.', 'I recommend that you watch it.' 'Suggest' ise daha çok bir fikir ortaya atmaktır.

quiz.cloze: The waiter ______ the fish soup, so we ordered it.

def.micro: a thing you play music on
def.short: an object like a guitar, piano or drum that you use to make music
def.long: An object that you use to make music, for example a guitar, a piano, a violin or a drum. Some people play an instrument as a hobby, and some play in a band.

examples.en: Hana's favourite instrument is the violin, but she also plays the piano a little.
examples.tr: Hana'nın en sevdiği çalgı keman, ama biraz da piyano çalıyor.

examples.en: Burak wants to learn an instrument, so he watches free piano videos every evening.
examples.tr: Burak bir enstrüman öğrenmek istiyor, bu yüzden her akşam ücretsiz piyano videoları izliyor.

etymology.text: From Latin 'instrumentum' (tool, equipment), from 'instruere' (to prepare, to equip).

tr.note: Türkçede 'çalmak' dense de İngilizcede çalgı için 'play' kullanılır: 'play the guitar'. 'Instrument' ayrıca doktorların ya da bilim insanlarının kullandığı alet demektir.

quiz.cloze: Tom can play three ______: the guitar, the drums and the piano.

def.micro: sing with the music you hear
def.short: sing a song at the same time as a singer, a recording or other people
def.long: To sing a song together with a singer you hear on the radio, at a concert or in a recording, or together with other people. People often do it at concerts, at parties and in the car.

examples.en: Everyone sang along at the concert.
Selin always sings along to the radio when she drives to work.
examples.tr: Selin işe arabayla giderken hep radyodaki şarkılara eşlik eder.

examples.en: I don't know all the words, but I always sing along to the chorus.
examples.tr: Sözlerin hepsini bilmiyorum, ama nakarata hep eşlik ediyorum.

tr.note: Neye eşlik ettiğini söylerken 'to' ya da 'with' gelir: 'sing along to the radio', 'sing along with the band'. Bitişik yazılan 'singalong' ise herkesin birlikte şarkı söylediği eğlence demektir.

quiz.cloze: My dad knows every word of this old song, so he always ______ when it plays.

def.short: an event where people can go and look at paintings, photos or other objects
def.long: An event, usually in a museum or gallery, where people can look at paintings, photos or other interesting objects for a period of time. Some exhibitions are free and some need a ticket.

grammar.pattern: an exhibition of sth / at an exhibition

examples.en: We saw a great photo exhibition today.
examples.tr: Bugün harika bir fotoğraf sergisi gördük.

examples.en: The new exhibition at the art gallery is free on Thursdays.
examples.tr: Sanat galerisindeki yeni sergi perşembeleri ücretsiz.

examples.en: Gül is a painter, and next month she is opening her first exhibition in Kadıköy.
examples.tr: Gül ressam ve gelecek ay Kadıköy'de ilk sergisini açıyor.

etymology.text: From Latin 'exhibitio', from 'exhibere' (to show, to hold out).

tr.note: Ortadaki 'h' okunmaz: 'eksıbişın'. ABD'de sanat sergisine çoğu zaman 'exhibit' de denir.

quiz.cloze: The museum has a new ______ of photos from old Istanbul.

def.short: the group of people who watch or listen to a concert, film, play or talk
def.long: The group of people who watch or listen to a concert, a film, a play, a talk or a TV programme. It can be people in a hall, a cinema or a theatre, or people watching at home.

examples.en: The audience clapped for a long time.
There was a small audience at the jazz night, but the music was wonderful.
examples.tr: Caz gecesinde az sayıda dinleyici vardı, ama müzik harikaydı.

examples.en: The comedian asked someone from the audience to come up on stage.
examples.tr: Komedyen seyircilerden birinden sahneye çıkmasını istedi.

tr.note: Türkçe 'seyirci' iki kelimeye denk gelir: konser, film ya da tiyatroda oturan izleyicilere 'audience', stadyumdaki ya da sokaktaki kalabalığa daha çok 'crowd' denir.

mistakes.why: Türkçede 'seyirciler' diye çoğul söyleriz; 'audience' ise salondaki insanların tamamını anlatan bir grup adıdır, bir salon için tekil kullanılır.

quiz.cloze: The singer smiled and waved to the ______ before the first song.
